patch.value: Count choice options from the JSON request representation

Canonicalize undefined object entries by JSON omission before admission counting and transport. Verify option identities and counts against real SDK loopback request bodies, including empty-choice refusal.

value.text: Decision: match official SDK JSON serialization by removing undefined object properties in the bounded detached input before schema validation and counting. Null retains an undescribed option; a sole undefined entry becomes empty and refuses before metadata. Compare admitted identities and counts with real SDK loopback requests.

patch.value:
Decision admission accepts an undefined-valued choice entry and counts it as an option, but the real SDK's JSON request drops that entry. This breaks the new admission promise that the checked options are exactly those submitted. Verified on `93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0` (PRs #92/#99) with the built package and a synthetic loopback endpoint. ### Exact source - [The input traversal skips undefined object values everywhere](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0/admission-schema.ts#L43-L48), including choice criteria, although its comment is about optional question fields. - [Choice validation counts the original keys and returns structured-cloned questions](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0/admission-schema.ts#L69-L79). - [Prompt construction counts each original choice entry and substitutes a description for undefined](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0/decision-admission.ts#L65-L77). - [runDecision submits those questions through the official SDK and then validates the response against the original entries](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0/index.ts#L402-L410). JSON serialization removes undefined-valued object properties. ### Reproduction Node 24.19.0, lockfile dependencies, and the committed supported metadata fixture. This exercises both the built admission function and a real TypeSafe SDK HTTP request; the server returns a valid answer for the options it actually receives. ```sh work=$(mktemp -d) git clone --quiet https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev.git "$work/package" cd "$work/package" git checkout --quiet 93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0 npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund npm run build cat > repro.mjs <<'EOF' import {createServer} from 'node:http'; import {admitDecision,runDecision,createJevClient} from './dist/index.js'; import {admissionMetadata} from './test/admission-fixtures.ts'; const seen=[]; const server=createServer(async(req,res)=>{let body='';for await(const chunk of req)body+=chunk;const input=body?JSON.parse(body):{};res.setHeader('content-type','application/json'); if(req.url==='/api/show'){res.end(JSON.stringify(admissionMetadata()));return;} seen.push(input);res.end(JSON.stringify({model:input.model,answers:{route:{type:'choice',choice:'keep',confidence:1,probabilities:{keep:1}}},usage:{input_tokens:1,output_tokens:1}}));}); await new Promise(r=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',r)); try{const config={provider:'ollama',baseUrl:`http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`,model:`sha256:${'a'.repeat(64)}`,timeoutMs:10000,totalDeadlineMs:10000}; const questions={route:{type:'choice',criteria:{keep:'Keep',drop:undefined}}}; const admitted=await admitDecision(config,'fixture',questions); console.log('admitted options:',admitted.receipt.options); try{await runDecision(createJevClient({config,hostedBlocked:null},{},0),config,'fixture',questions);}catch(e){console.log('result:',e.context?.code??e.code??e.name);} console.log('inference requests:',seen.length); console.log('wire options:',JSON.stringify(Object.keys(seen[0].questions.route.criteria))); console.log('admitted options preserved:',Object.keys(seen[0].questions.route.criteria).length===admitted.receipt.options); }finally{server.closeAllConnections();await new Promise(r=>server.close(r));} EOF PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 PM_AGENT_PROBES=0 NODE_ENV=test node repro.mjs ``` Observed output: ```text admitted options: 2 result: jev_malformed_answer inference requests: 1 wire options: ["keep"] admitted options preserved: false ``` ### Expected / actual Expected: reject undefined choice descriptions with `invalid_input` and a remedy before metadata/inference, or deliberately normalize them to `null` before both admission and transport so every option survives. An affirmative receipt must describe the request actually submitted. Actual: `criteria: {keep:'Keep', drop:undefined}` is admitted as two options, but the inference request contains only `keep`. One inference call is made before `jev_malformed_answer` rejects a response that is valid for the transmitted question. A sole undefined entry would serialize as an empty criteria object. ### Impact and fix direction Programmatic producers can silently lose a decision alternative after admission, invalidate prompt-token accounting, and waste an inference before the mismatch surfaces. This is an SDK-object input issue; JSON CLI input cannot directly represent undefined. Limit the undefined exception to genuinely optional schema fields, or normalize undescribed choice entries explicitly to null in the shared detached representation. Add a wire-level regression comparing admitted option identities/counts with the serialized request, including the single-option case. Duplicate check: searched all issue states for `undefined criteria` and `admission options`, and inspected the issue inventory; no matching issue found. --- ### GitHub comments (1) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-06T11:02:26Z) > > > > >
